claim_boundary: A pass proves only monthly long-or-cash risk reduction for the named level series. It does not prove futures roll implementation, carry, leverage, shorting, ticker selection, entry/target/stop, or other commodities/FX pairs.
cost: 25 bps one-way on every exposure change, deducted in the month of the switch.

input.data_limit: Bundled monthly level series; spot/index histories, not total-return tradable futures portfolios.

multiplicity: Three frozen transport assets; no formula, lookback, split or threshold search.
purpose: Confirm whether the already-proven US monthly SMA10 exposure-reduction rule transports without retuning to gold, oil and the broad US-dollar index as a risk control, not an alpha or short signal.
rule: At each month t, if completed prior-month level is at or above its prior-month rolling 10-month simple average, hold long exposure during month t; otherwise hold cash. No shorting. One-month execution lag is mandatory.
